Was a part of the original design? I'm thinking if this is worth the trouble. Having the authorization list: 1. (A, nonce=1) 2. (A, nonce=0) 3. (A, nonce=1) We have: 1. no refund because fails but creates the account. 2. refund although A exists. 3. no refund because A exists. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/9355 Nice, thank you.

excerpts.author: chfast
excerpts.content:
Having the authorization list:
1. (A, nonce=1)
2. (A, nonce=0)
3. (A, nonce=1)

We have:

1. no refund because fails but creates the account.
2. refund although A exists.
3. no refund because A exists.
